title: The Tiger and the Mice
text: In a mango grove, a tiger was dozing under a tree.
A tiny mouse whispered, "Please let me pass, I need to gather mango seeds."
The tiger opened his eyes and let the mouse go.
Later, the tiger got its paw caught in a hunter's net.
The mouse chewed the ropes, freeing the tiger, and they became friends.

title: The Crow and the Water Pot
text: A thirsty crow found a half‑filled earthen pot in a village courtyard.
He tried to drink but the water was too low.
Thinking quickly, the crow dropped small pebbles into the pot.
Each pebble raised the water level.
Soon the water rose high enough, and the crow quenched his thirst.

title: The Monkey and the Coconut
text: In a coconut grove, a playful monkey saw a ripe coconut on the ground.
He tried to open it with his hands but could not crack the husk.
A nearby elephant offered to smash it with his trunk.
The monkey thanked the elephant and shared the sweet coconut meat.
They ate together, enjoying the jungle feast.

title: The Tortoise and the Hare
text: In a sunny field of wheat, a swift hare bragged about his speed.
A slow tortoise challenged him to a race across the paddy.
The hare sprinted ahead and took a nap under a banana leaf.
The tortoise kept moving, step by step.
When the hare woke, the tortoise had already reached the finish line.

title: The Fox and the Grapes
text: A clever fox prowled a vineyard, eyeing ripe grapes.
He jumped high but the grapes hung too far on a vine.
After many tries, he gave up and walked away.
He muttered, "Those grapes were probably sour anyway."
He laughed and went to hunt for a juicy mango instead.

title: The Hippo and the Lesson
text: In a bright Indian forest, a hippo was playing near a mango tree.
A little bird sang, "Beware of curiosity."
The hippo laughed and continued its fun.
Soon, a problem appeared that required curiosity.
With curiosity, the hippo solved it and felt happy.
